info.title: vMCP Control Plane API
info.description:
Configuration API of the vMCP gateway. The web UI is a client of this API:
**everything the UI can do, an external system can do.**

## Design principles for integrations

- **Stable identifiers.** Resources are addressed by `slug` (client-chosen, immutable),
  never by generated IDs, so scripts and pipelines can refer to them before they exist.
- **Idempotent writes.** `PUT /{resource}/{slug}` creates or replaces (201 on create, 200 on
  replace). Repeating the same call is safe.
- **Declarative mode.** `GET /export` and `POST /apply` move the whole configuration as one
  document, atomically, with `dryRun` and optional `prune`. This is the intended GitOps path.
- **Secrets are write-only.** Upstream `headers` values are never returned. Responses expose
  only `headerNames`. On writes, omitting `headers` keeps the stored secret, so exported
  documents can be re-applied without ever containing secrets.
- **Optimistic concurrency.** Every resource carries an `ETag`. Send it back in `If-Match`
  on `PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` to avoid lost updates (`412` on mismatch). `If-Match` is optional.
- **Machine-readable errors.** All errors are `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with a
  stable `code`.
- **Propagation.** Mutating responses carry `X-VMCP-Config-Revision`. The data plane serves
  the change once it has loaded that revision (normally well under a second).

## Naming rule

Tools are exposed to agents as `{upstreamSlug}__{tool}` unless an `alias` is given.
Slugs cannot contain `_`, so `__` is an unambiguous separator.

## Tenancy

Single tenant (`default`) today. The data model is tenant-scoped, and tenant selection
will be added without changing these paths.

get.summary: The authenticated caller and its role
get.description:
Roles: `viewer` (read only), `editor` (changes configuration, cannot manage admin tokens),
`admin` (everything). Admin tokens map `read` to `viewer` and `admin` to `admin`; the
bootstrap token is `admin`; browser sign-in (OIDC) maps IdP groups to a role.

get.summary: List upstreams

post.description:
Creating an upstream does not contact it. Call `refresh-tools` afterwards (or use
`connection-tests` first) to fetch its tool schemas.

get.summary: Get an upstream

put.description:
Full replacement of the writable fields. `headers` semantics: omitted keeps the stored
headers; `{}` clears them; an object replaces them entirely.

patch.summary: Partially update an upstream (JSON Merge Patch, RFC 7396)
patch.description:
Only the given fields change. Within `headers`, a `null` value deletes that single header,
so one secret can be rotated without resending the others.

delete.description:
Fails with 409 `in_use` while virtual servers still select its tools, unless `force=true`,
which also removes those selections.

get.summary: Cached tool schemas of an upstream
get.description: Returns what the last `refresh-tools` fetched. It does not contact the upstream.

post.summary: Connect to the upstream and re-fetch its tool schemas
post.description:
Safe to call repeatedly. Tools that disappeared upstream but are still selected by a
virtual server are reported in `orphanedSelections`. They are kept in the configuration
but not served until the tool reappears.

502.description: The upstream could not be reached or answered with an error.

post.summary: Try connecting to an MCP server without saving anything
post.description: Used by the UI before registering an upstream. Nothing is persisted.

200.description: Outcome of the attempt (a failed connection is still a 200 with `ok=false`).

put.summary: Create or replace a virtual server (idempotent)
put.description:
The `tools` list is replaced atomically. Every selection must reference an existing upstream
and a tool in its cached schema (`unknown_upstream`, `unknown_tool`), and exposed names
must be unique (`duplicate_exposed_name`).

patch.description: Merge-patch replaces arrays wholesale, so a patched `tools` list is the new list.

Maps claims of an IdP-issued JWT (see `VMCP_AGENT_OIDC_*`) to virtual servers. All
conditions must match (AND). Access is denied unless a matching binding lists the virtual
server and the client IP passes its allowlist.

post.description: Nothing is authenticated or changed; use it to debug claim conditions.

token.description: Raw JWT string (hashed with SHA-256 before storage; never stored in plaintext).

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Filter by recorded origin. Virtual includes virtual MCP events and explicitly linked upstream attempts; control includes control-plane reads/writes and their linked upstream attempts; system includes background activity; upstream selects upstream-scope events only. Omit for all events, including unclassified legacy events.

parameters.name: incomplete
parameters.description: Admissions without a persisted outcome (includes in-flight calls).

get.summary: Export the whole configuration as a declarative document
get.description:
Secrets are never included. The document can be committed to git and re-applied; stored
upstream headers are preserved because `headers` is absent from it.

post.summary: Make the configuration match a declarative document
post.description:
Applied in a single transaction: either everything changes or nothing does.

- Resources in the document are created or updated; unchanged ones are left alone.
- With `prune=true`, resources **absent** from the document are deleted. Without it they
  are left untouched.
- Tool schemas of new or changed upstreams are fetched before virtual servers are
  validated, unless `refreshTools=false`.
- `dryRun=true` validates and reports the plan without changing anything.

post.summary: Test stored upstream credentials without returning them

get.summary: Read discovered resources, templates, prompts and capabilities

post.summary: Preview a saved REST operation without sending it
post.description: Validates arguments and returns the prepared URL/body with masked header values. No network access or impersonation. Editor or admin required.

post.summary: Execute a saved REST operation once (admin only)
post.description: Real operation with possible side effects. Requires admin, enabled upstream and matching If-Match. Never impersonates an agent; identity-required operations must be tested through MCP. No retries. Errors are sanitized MCP tool results.

200.description: MCP tool result; isError indicates REST failure

post.summary: Analyze OpenAPI/Swagger operations without saving or contacting a service
post.description: Editor/admin only. Upload document contents as a string. Returns selectable REST operation definitions and per-operation compatibility warnings/errors. Use existing upstream CRUD with the explicitly selected operations to save; existing REST validation, credentials, ETags and audit controls still apply. No credentials, headers, TLS settings or agent identity forwarding are imported. Unsupported media, methods, serialization, external or recursive references are not silently converted.

Forbidden.description: The token is valid but its scope does not allow this request (`code: forbidden`).

Conflict.description: Slug already exists (`already_exists`) or resource still referenced (`in_use`).

PreconditionFailed.description: `If-Match` did not match the current ETag (`code: precondition_failed`).

Unprocessable.description:
Well-formed but invalid. `errors` lists every problem, not just the first.
Codes: `validation_failed`, `unknown_upstream`, `unknown_tool`, `duplicate_exposed_name`.

UpstreamTLSInput.description:
Per-upstream TLS. `caPem` (a CA, or the self-signed certificate itself) becomes the **only**
trusted root for this upstream and is applied to tool discovery, health checks, connection
tests and agent sessions. There is intentionally no way to disable verification.
On writes the whole block replaces the stored settings; omit the block to keep them.
An omitted `clientKeyPem` keeps the stored key.

caPem.description: PEM bundle of up to 10 certificates.

serverName.description: Host name used for SNI and certificate verification (needed when reaching the server by IP or an alias).

clientKeyPem.description: Private key of `clientCertPem`. Encrypted at rest, never returned or exported.

UpstreamAuthInput.description:
Gateway-to-upstream authentication. Supports `oauth_client_credentials` where the gateway
fetches and caches tokens from an OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. Setting type to `none` removes
configured OAuth settings. Cannot be combined with a static `Authorization` header.

audience.description: Optional audience parameter sent to the token endpoint.

ToolPolicy.description:
Which of the virtual server's tools agents may see and call. Blocked tools are hidden from
`tools/list`, calls to them are refused and audited as `denied`. `read_only` passes only tools
whose upstream declares `readOnlyHint: true`; tools without annotations are blocked.

tools.description: Per-tool override, keyed by exposed tool name.

PiiConfig.description:
Masks personal data in tool results (and optionally arguments) before they leave the
gateway. Matches become `[REDACTED:<TYPE>]`. Built-in detectors with checksum validation:
`iban`, `credit_card`, `tckn`, `us_ssn`; pattern-based: `email`, `phone`.
Custom rules use RE2 syntax (no backtracking).

detectors.description: Built-in detectors to apply. Empty means all of them.

pattern.description: RE2 regular expression; must not match the empty string.

maskArguments.description: Also mask tool arguments before they reach the upstream.

lastUsedAt.description: Refreshed at most once a minute.
Refreshed at most once a minute.

token.description: The secret. Shown once; store it now.

deadLetters.description: Process-local permanent write rejections; no durable dead-letter queue is implied.

subject.description: JWT `sub` when the caller used an IdP token (`agentKey` is then `oauth:<binding>`).

status.description: `tool_error` = the tool ran and reported isError; `error` = the call failed.

redactions.description: Number of PII values masked in this call.

bindings.description: Identity bindings. When the key is absent they are neither applied nor pruned.

revision.description: Revision after applying. `null` for a dry run.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable machine-readable `code`.

field.description: JSON pointer to the offending field, e.g. `/tools/2/tool`.

instructions.description: Cached upstream initialization instructions; published only when explicitly selected by a virtual server.

Guidance.description: Additive virtual-server guidance, limited to 512 KiB. Omission on PUT preserves saved guidance; an empty object clears it. Tool tokens use {{tool:key}}; prompt messages also accept {{arg:name}}. Templates perform literal substitution only. Arrays may be null in responses for empty configuration.

GuidancePatch.description: Only supplied non-null members are replaced. Omitted/null members are preserved; empty arrays clear collections and an empty string clears instructions.

messages.description: Message text must total at most 20000 characters.

RESTAuth.description: Omitted or empty credentials preserve stored secrets when the auth type is unchanged. Change type to none to clear authentication. HTTPS is required unless allowInsecureHttp is enabled. OAuth token endpoint uses system TLS trust.

exposeToMcp.description: Omitted or true exposes the parameter as an MCP argument. False requires defaultValue, sends it as a fixed value, and rejects attempts to supply this argument.

defaultValue.description: Explicit scalar fallback, validated against schema. Used only when the MCP argument is absent; makes an exposed parameter optional. For hidden parameters this is a fixed value. schema.default alone does not enable fallback. Null is not supported.

schema.description: Inline JSON Schema with scalar type string, number, integer or boolean. Path parameters without defaultValue are always required.

request.description: WireMock request matchers. Method, URL path, IDs and namespace are managed by vMCP.

jsonBody.description: JSON reply; mutually exclusive with body.

mockRules.description: Response rules for mock upstreams only. Enabled mock operations require at least one rule; at most 1000 rules per upstream.

path.description: Appended to base URL. Starts with one slash; no query, fragments, escapes or traversal segments.

bodySchema.description: Optional inline JSON Schema. Adds required body argument; forbidden for GET.

responseSchema.description: Optional inline JSON Schema validated before response field projection. No schema references supported.

responseFieldPaths.description: Literal property-name paths for nested response projection. Arrays are traversed implicitly for every item, preserving order and length. Mutually exclusive with nonempty responseFields. Empty or omitted paths disable nested projection. Requires declared object/array schemas; complex branches can be selected whole.

responseFields.description: Legacy top-level literal property names. Mutually exclusive with nonempty responseFieldPaths.

headers.description: Encrypted write-only operation headers. Omit to preserve by operation name; empty object clears. Override common headers case-insensitively. Reserved headers are rejected.

readOnly.description: Only GET may be marked read-only. Defaults false.

namespace.description: Managed identifier derived from deployment tenant and upstream slug. Supplied values are replaced on save.

mock.description: Opt into shared WireMock integration. Requires VMCP_WIREMOCK_URL on the control plane. URL is replaced by the configured endpoint on save; mock mode cannot change after creation. No WireMock call occurs within the configuration transaction.

RESTConfig.description: REST configuration (max 512 KiB). When supplied this block replaces configuration, preserving omitted secrets and per-operation headers. Omit the entire block to retain it. Agent identity is derived only from authenticated sessions; requireIdentity also requires forwardIdentity. No redirects, fallbacks or automatic operation retries.

RESTImportOperation.description: Unsupported operations remain visible with errors and no operation. Import never selects or publishes operations.

RESTImportResult.description: Preview limited to 8 MiB. Server declarations are informational only; connection/security settings are never applied. Local references are expanded into inline schemas; external/cyclic references are rejected per operation.

document.description: Complete UTF-8 JSON/YAML document, at most 2 MiB (byte limit). Swagger 2.0 or OpenAPI 3.0/3.1. No URL fetching, YAML aliases or multi-document streams.

CallerContextConfig.description: Call-scoped metadata forwarding rules. Omission preserves settings; an empty object clears them. Values are supplied per call, not stored in this configuration. Tokens are validated by the upstream.

metaKey.description: Namespaced metadata key, such as com.bank/caller-context.

header.description: Target HTTP header for REST upstreams only.

bearer.description: Prefix the value with Bearer for an Authorization target.
